source.rule: The entry has exactly two different ligands, one copy each; the request gives two colours, "one ... and the other ...". Accepted: both assignments. On the API track each reading is accepted in every call form that ends in a state of its own: (default) one colour call on a bare load, which leaves everything else as the viewer draws it; (style) the cartoon style set first, so that only the polymer is drawn and a ligand asked for as ball-and-stick is an added representation, which is the state the MVS twin draws; (author, chain colours only) each chain named by its author id on a bare load, which also paints the ligands, ions and water deposited under that author chain. The request says nothing about what it does not name, so none of these is wrong.
accepted_states: CAM yellow, HEM purple; the cartoon style set first
CAM purple, HEM yellow; the cartoon style set first
not_accepted: both ligands the same colour, or only one ligand shown: the request asks for both, in different colours
ions, water or bonded protein residues shown as ligands: not ligands of the entry

an added representation in the requested colour on top of a default drawing that was given another colour or none (bare load, 'representation' + 'representationColor' with no matching 'color'): the ligand is then drawn twice, in two colours
another global style, or hidden components: not requested
